source_inverse: existing invert_grey.invert; geometry supplied by known renderer assumptions, parameters recovered from image pixels
limits: The SVD encoder consumes an observed direction; its coefficients are not a learned state-to-direction law.
Image alignment uses known straight-stroke geometry and an existing inverse; this is not blind coordinate discovery.
Integer registration is reversible and uses no resampling; pixel/subrow phase remains.
A generic unregistered boundary event may have two one-sided derivatives; these are tested separately.
No spatial map, phase list, cluster label or parameter is stored beyond the counted alignment scalars.

shared_three_field_decoder.note: Uses known nonlinear family identities; this is a shared compression decoder, not a newly learned state-only predictor.

exact_event_checks.side_aware_metadata: At events: five source-derived geometry scalars, known knob identity, plus one bit selecting the requested one-sided derivative. Rounding ties use an explicit tolerance of 1e-10.
exact_event_checks.note: At box boundaries a side can leave the sampling box; render supports those infinitesimal moves. Event tests may expose an unseen registration branch.

additional_event_audit.selection: 32 new states generated independently after choosing side-aware registration, no basis refit or model tuning
